page.content:
Amazon animated series adapted from Campaign 1.

How The Legend of Vox Machina connects

  • Work: Campaign 1 — The Legend of Vox Machina adapts Campaign 1.
  • Work: Campaign 1 — Campaign 1 was adapted into The Legend of Vox Machina.
  • Faction: Vox Machina — Vox Machina is the adventuring party of the animated series.
  • Faction: Critical Role Productions — Critical Role Productions made The Legend of Vox Machina with Amazon.

What is The Legend of Vox Machina?

The Legend of Vox Machina is the Prime Video series that adapts Vox Machina's Whitestone and dragon arcs, with the cast voicing their Campaign 1 characters.

Key threads lead to Campaign 1, Campaign 1, Vox Machina and Critical Role Productions.
